prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: low-speed head-on collision in Houston, Texas. Injury: neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1081; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving home on a weekday afternoon when the car in front of me suddenly slowed, and I braked as firmly as I could. The vehicle coming the other way drifted into my lane, and despite my efforts to steer clear, we made contact nose to nose. Both cars were moving slowly, so the impact was mild, but my head snapped forward and back. I have been the policyholder on this coverage for several years, and I am the person listed on the policy for the vehicle I was driving. I got out of the car and spoke with the other driver and the responding officer. I have told the same account of what happened to everyone who has asked, and I have kept the details consistent from the scene onward. The next morning I woke with stiffness and soreness in my neck, which a doctor later diagnosed as a neck strain. I am submitting this statement so that my claim can be reviewed.
